# input: # A hosts line is text from the suspect host that is quoted into a finding's
# detail, which the path extractor, the allowlist and the IOC pass all read.
# Each field must come out reduced to the characters it can legally contain.
# NO COLUMN MAY BE EMPTY: bash read collapses consecutive TABs. Write "-".
# Inputs here use spaces only; the TAB-separated case lives in each harness
# because a literal TAB cannot sit inside a TAB-separated column.

note: runs of spaces collapse and aliases are kept
an address with no name is still reported
a drive path cannot survive, so it cannot reach paths[] or an allowlist rule
the address field is held to address characters
shell and formula metacharacters are neutralised
a separator cannot smuggle a second token
